summary: community.zabbix breaking changes: roles drop CentOS 7, Python 2, Debian 10 and Ubuntu 18.04, Ansible below 2.15, Python below 3.9 and Zabbix 6.2. The zabbix_agent role removes zabbix_agent_zabbix_alias, zabbix_get_package, zabbix_sender_package and all zabbix_agent2_* variables.
questions: Can the zabbix roles still deploy to CentOS 7?
Is Zabbix 6.2 still supported by community.zabbix?

answer_card.title: community.zabbix breaking changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- Roles no longer support CentOS 7, Debian 10, Ubuntu 18.04 or Python 2.
- Requires Ansible 2.15+ and Python 3.9+. Zabbix 6.2 is no longer supported.
- `zabbix_agent` role: `zabbix_agent_zabbix_alias`, `zabbix_get_package`, `zabbix_sender_package` and all `zabbix_agent2_*` variables are removed.
